notes: Focused public C++ TCK contract for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §4.1.7 p. 50 l. 126-41 and §12.5 p. 357 l. 58-18. A protected RID profile supplies two distinct, valid service values; both test services independently authorize empty HLAnoCredentials. Public Connect must reject the profile, so silently selecting either configured service would fail the test. The contract claims only a failed Connect, not a normative exception class. This is implementation-specific RID behavior exercised by an adapter-specific provider bridge, not provider interoperability or full conformance.
